scope: Selected visual observations from original JPEGs, not an exhaustive inventory or a decipherment. Rectangles use x, y, width, height in original pixels and may include whitespace.

notes.title: Cuneiform-like mark below the text
notes.text: A compact black mark occupies two rows below the final rune row. The community name cuneiform-like describes its appearance, not an established historical sign or translation. The inspection window includes surrounding whitespace.

notes.title: Three separated black dots
notes.text: Three large black dots form a horizontal row between the upper and lower text blocks. These are visually distinct from the much smaller punctuation clusters within the text.

notes.title: Enlarged red opening runes
notes.text: Each of the two text blocks begins with a large red rune extending alongside its first three text rows. Smaller red runes and red punctuation clusters also appear at the starts of the blocks. This records placement and color, not an instruction to extract them.

notes.text: A compact black mark occupies two rows above the rune text. Compare LP2-33, where the corresponding motif appears below the text. Similar appearance does not establish pixel identity. The inspection window includes surrounding whitespace.
